court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
case_name: Shivani And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another
facts_of_case: Petitioners are husband and wife, seeking custody of minor wife. Victim left home after scolding from mother, claimed to have married petitioner no.2 voluntarily.

legal_principles.principle: The husband is the natural guardian of a married woman.
legal_principles.held: As per Section 6 of the Hindu Minority and Guardianship Act, 1956, the husband is the natural guardian of a married woman.
applicable_acts_sections: Hindu Minority and Guardianship Act — Section 6

legal_principles.principle: The court shall not appoint or declare any person as a guardian against the will of a minor married girl if the marriage adheres to Clause (iii) of Section 5 of The Hindu Marriage Act.
legal_principles.held: Section 17(5) of the Guardians and Wards Act, 1890 stipulates that the Court shall not appoint or declare any person as a guardian against the will of a minor married girl if the marriage adheres to Clause (iii) of Section 5 of The Hindu Marriage Act, rendering it neither void nor voidable.

legal_principles.principle: The natural guardian of a minor has the right to custody, and the court shall not appoint any other person as a guardian against their will.
legal_principles.held: Considering Sections 19 and 21 of The Guardians and Wards Act in conjunction with Sections 6, 10, and 13 of the Hindu Minority and Guardianship Act, 1956, petitioner no.2 is the natural guardian of petitioner no.1, given their marital union.
applicable_acts_sections: Guardians and Wards Act — Sections 19 and 21
Hindu Minority and Guardianship Act — Sections 6, 10, and 13

legal_principles.principle: The court shall not appoint a guardian against the will of a minor, if the marriage is valid and solemnized with the consent of the minor.
legal_principles.held: Considering Sections 19 and 21 of The Guardians and Wards Act in conjunction with Sections 6, 10, and 13 of the Hindu Minority and Guardianship Act, 1956, petitioner no.2 is the natural guardian of petitioner no.1, given their marital union.
applicable_acts_sections: Guardians and Wards Act — Sections 19 and 21
Hindu Minority and Guardianship Act — Sections 6, 10, and 13

outcome.final_order: Order dated 11.1.2023 set aside; petitioners granted custody of minor wife.
